# AdControl Learning

> Free practical courses on digital marketing, SEO, GEO, SEM, affiliate marketing, analytics and conversion optimization.

## Endpoints
- Homepage: https://marketing.nevatal.id/
- API: https://marketing.nevatal.id/api/v3/catalog/courses
- API Catalog: https://marketing.nevatal.id/.well-known/api-catalog
- Agent Card: https://marketing.nevatal.id/.well-known/agent-card.json
- AI Catalog: https://marketing.nevatal.id/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- Authentication Guide: https://marketing.nevatal.id/auth.md
